cues: With plurals and uncountables used in general: books are cheap in Bhotahity; honesty pays.
With names of people, cities, single mountains, lakes and countries: Everest, not the Everest.
With languages, subjects, games, meals and festivals.
With institutions used for their purpose: she goes to school, meaning to study; but she goes to the school to meet the principal, meaning the building.
And with transport after by: by bus, by air.
text: And no article at all. With plurals and uncountables used in general: books are cheap in Bhotahity; honesty pays. With names of people, cities, single mountains, lakes and countries: Everest, not the Everest. With languages, subjects, games, meals and festivals. With institutions used for their purpose: she goes to school, meaning to study; but she goes to the school to meet the principal, meaning the building. And with transport after by: by bus, by air.
